name: locator-inspector-overlay
description: A live, on-page overlay that grades every button/link/input's test-locator stability **while you're actually using the app** — and auto-catches every toast, error banner, and validation message the instant it appears, even if it vanishes in under a second. No browser extension, no IT approval, no admin install: it's a bookmarklet, so it works instantly even in locked-down managed browsers (e.g. **Island**, which blocks most extensions by policy).
